title: Side Trails
message: Side Trails is where independent Waypoint projects live. Waypoint Deck is the current Side Trail.

projects.title: Waypoint Deck
projects.tagline: Offline-first Linux field computer · local AI · maps, weather, radio, knowledge.
projects.description: An independent Side Trail exploring resilient field computing when connectivity is poor or gone. Planned capabilities include offline maps/GPS, local AI, weather, radio/SDR, offline reference knowledge, sensors, and situational awareness when online. Early-stage — do not assume these systems already ship.
